title: Scaling Code-Assisted Chain-of-Thoughts and Instructions for Model Reasoning
authors_zh: Honglin Lin, Qizhi Pei, Zhuoshi Pan, Yu Li, Xin Gao, Juntao Li, Conghui He, Lijun Wu
paper_type_zh: 可执行推理数据发布与合成构建流水线
best_for_zh: 研究可执行中间表示、合成推理数据扩展、SFT 语料构建与 verifier/谱系审计的读者
one_line: Caco converts four source mixtures into 146K verified seed programs, samples about 5.3M new programs, and releases 1,348,799 reversed instruction-solution rows with their answers and code after multi-stage filtering.
Caco 将四类来源数据转为 146K 条已验证种子程序，再采样约 5.3M 个程序，并在多级过滤后发布 1,348,799 条带答案与代码的反向构造指令—解答记录。
why: It makes executable code a scalable intermediate data contract, while showing why program execution, model agreement, incomplete lineage, and benchmark gains must be audited separately from semantic correctness and data quality.
inclusion_reason: Caco is a core data-construction/open-release recipe because it publishes a large instruction-CoT corpus and documents a multi-stage path from heterogeneous source solutions through executable program abstraction, unconditional program scaling, problem reversal, answer comparison, and model-based consistency filtering.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The formal record is the NeurIPS 2025 proceedings paper, with arXiv:2510.04081 providing the full text and appendix. This Card also checks the official GitHub repository at commit ceb525c57a9fea22dd2d0cf84bfc9dc2f5169375 and the official Hugging Face dataset at revision 664f036126e9b82533c769b74ef27c7c0ccd1398, as visible on 21 July 2026. The formal author order is preserved in the metadata.

Caco addresses a scaling problem in reasoning-data construction. Rewriting an existing question changes surface form but tends to preserve its reasoning pattern, while asking a large language model to invent both a new problem and a solution lacks a dependable correctness anchor. Caco instead treats an executable Python program as an intermediate reasoning object: standardize source solutions into programs, learn to sample new programs without a problem prompt, execute and filter them, then reconstruct natural-language questions and solutions.

The released object is currently one Hugging Face train split with exactly 1,348,799 rows. Each row has four string fields: instruction, output, answer, and code. instruction is the reversed problem; output is its natural-language chain of thought and final response; answer is the extracted final answer; and code is the executable Code CoT from which the instruction was reconstructed. The single file, cacov2_1.3M.jsonl, is 3,130,228,421 bytes and has LFS SHA-256 919050aa7495d1811999c1ff0f7eec1675abaf061ffa5eedddc96168d8d5e946. There is no released validation/test split.

The source mixture contains MATH (7.5K), DeepScaleR (40K), BigMath (251K), and KodCode (40K). Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct translates their solutions into a common program template; execution and available answer checks retain 146K seed programs, reported as 122K math and 24K algorithmic/code records. An unconditional Qwen2.5-Coder-7B generator then samples about 5.3M programs, structural/execution filtering retains about 4.6M, and problem reversal plus language-solution generation and final checks produce the released 1.3M-scale corpus.

This is directly in scope for data_construction_open_release_recipes: the paper identifies the data object, synthesis stages, feedback layers, scale funnel, SFT use, and an open artifact. The partial status is also material. The release omits row-level source and parent lineage, execution logs, per-stage decisions, rejected candidates, full generation/reversal/judge code, and decontamination evidence; those absences prevent complete reproduction or audit even though the final rows and some filtering/training helpers are public.

正式论文记录来自 NeurIPS 2025 proceedings，arXiv:2510.04081 提供完整正文与 appendix。本卡还检查了官方 GitHub 仓库 commit ceb525c57a9fea22dd2d0cf84bfc9dc2f5169375，以及 2026 年 7 月 21 日可见的官方 Hugging Face dataset revision 664f036126e9b82533c769b74ef27c7c0ccd1398。元数据保留正式会议页面给出的作者顺序。

Caco 处理的是 reasoning-data construction 的扩展难题。改写已有问题通常只改变表面形式，仍保留原有 reasoning pattern；让大语言模型同时发明新问题和解答，则缺少可靠的 correctness anchor。Caco 把可执行 Python 程序作为中间 reasoning object：先把来源解答统一为程序，再学习一个不接收问题 prompt 的程序生成器，执行并过滤新程序，最后反向构造自然语言问题与解答。

当前 release 只有一个 Hugging Face train split，共 1,348,799 行。每行包含四个字符串字段：instruction、output、answer 与 code。instruction 是反向构造的问题；output 是自然语言 chain of thought 与最终回复；answer 是抽取出的最终答案；code 是用于反向构造该指令的可执行 Code CoT。单一文件 cacov2_1.3M.jsonl 大小为 3,130,228,421 bytes，LFS SHA-256 为 919050aa7495d1811999c1ff0f7eec1675abaf061ffa5eedddc96168d8d5e946。没有发布 validation/test split。

来源 mixture 包括 MATH（7.5K）、DeepScaleR（40K）、BigMath（251K）与 KodCode（40K）。Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 把其中的解答转换到共同程序模板；execution 与可用 answer check 留下 146K 个 seed program，其中报告为 122K math 与 24K algorithmic/code record。随后，无条件 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B generator 采样约 5.3M 个程序，结构与执行过滤保留约 4.6M，再经过 problem reversal、language-solution generation 与最终检查，得到公开的 1.3M 规模 corpus。

它直接属于 data_construction_open_release_recipes：论文明确给出 data object、synthesis stage、feedback layer、规模 funnel、SFT 用法与开放 artifact。partial 状态同样关键。发布物缺少逐行 source/parent lineage、execution log、逐阶段 decision、rejected candidate、完整 generation/reversal/judge code 与 decontamination evidence；因此，虽然最终记录和部分过滤/训练辅助代码已开放，仍不能完整复现或审计构造过程。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Caco moves augmentation from question space into executable reasoning-program space. Its CodeGen model sees only standardized Code CoTs during training and samples programs unconditionally at inference. A generated program can therefore recombine decompositions, intermediate computations, and control structure without being anchored to a seed question's wording. A separate model then infers a plausible instruction from the program and representative input-output examples.

The feedback contract has four distinct layers:

  1. Reference-backed seed verification. Converted seed programs must parse and run; when a source answer is available, execution output must match it. This is the strongest layer because an external expected answer constrains the program.
  2. Program validity and structure. Generated programs must execute within 10 seconds, contain at least six non-comment lines, and use every input-dictionary variable according to AST analysis. These tests establish bounded execution and nontrivial syntactic structure, not mathematical truth.
  3. Cross-representation answer agreement. After Qwen3-8B generates an instruction and a separate language CoT, the extracted language answer is compared with the program's output. This detects direct answer disagreement but can preserve the same mistake on both sides.
  4. Model-based semantic judgment. Qwen3-32B judges problem solvability, answer correctness, and consistency between code and language reasoning. The paper supplies yes/no prompts, but not record-level decisions, judge calibration against humans/formal solvers, thresholds beyond the binary answers, or disagreement handling.

The resulting supervision is mixed. Released instruction/output pairs provide sequence-level SFT targets; answer supports answer-level checking; code exposes the intermediate executable trace for audit or derived experiments. The paper trains downstream models only with supervised fine-tuning/distillation-style synthetic supervision. It proposes RL with verifiable rewards as future work; there is no reported RL objective, policy rollout, reward study, or RL-trained result, so the Card does not add rlvr.

The closest conceptual families are problem-rewriting augmentation, teacher-generated reasoning distillation, and execution-filtered code synthesis. Caco's specific contribution is their ordering: unify heterogeneous solutions into executable patterns, generate patterns without prompts, then reverse them into instructions under answer and semantic checks. The novelty is an integrated scalable data-construction recipe and open final corpus, not a proof that program execution guarantees semantic correctness.

The paper's current release is more auditable than an instruction/output-only corpus because it includes answer and code. It remains less auditable than the construction process itself: execution outputs, representative test inputs, source IDs, generator parents, acceptance/rejection labels, prompt/model revisions, and judge rationales are not attached to rows.

Caco 把 augmentation 从 question space 移到可执行 reasoning-program space。CodeGen 训练时只观察标准化 Code CoT，推理时无条件采样程序。因此，生成程序可以重组 decomposition、intermediate computation 与 control structure，而不受某个 seed question 表述的直接约束。另一个模型再依据程序及其代表性 input-output example 推断出合理指令。

反馈契约分为四个不能混为一谈的层次：

  1. 带外部答案的种子验证。 转换后的 seed program 必须可解析、可运行；若来源数据有答案，execution output 必须与其一致。这一层约束最强，因为程序受到外部 expected answer 的限制。
  2. 程序有效性与结构。 生成程序必须在 10 秒内执行结束，至少包含 6 行非注释代码，并由 AST analysis 确认 input dictionary 中每个变量都被使用。这些测试证明有界执行与非平凡句法结构，却不能证明数学真值。
  3. 跨表示答案一致性。 Qwen3-8B 生成 instruction 与独立 language CoT 后，抽取出的 language answer 会与程序输出比较。它可以发现直接答案冲突，但若两侧共享同一个错误，仍可能通过。
  4. 模型语义判断。 Qwen3-32B 判断 problem solvability、answer correctness，以及 code reasoning 与 language reasoning 的一致性。论文提供 yes/no prompt，但没有发布逐记录 decision、相对于人工或形式求解器的 judge calibration、二元答案之外的 threshold，或 disagreement handling。

最终 supervision 是 mixed。发布的 instruction/output pair 提供 sequence-level SFT target；answer 支持 answer-level check；code 暴露可审计或可派生实验的中间可执行 trace。论文只用 supervised fine-tuning／distillation-style synthetic supervision 训练下游模型。RL with verifiable rewards 仅是 future work；没有报告 RL objective、policy rollout、reward study 或 RL-trained result，因此本卡不加入 rlvr。

概念上最接近的路线包括 problem-rewriting augmentation、teacher-generated reasoning distillation 与 execution-filtered code synthesis。Caco 的具体贡献在于编排顺序：把异构解答统一成可执行 pattern，不依赖 prompt 问题生成新 pattern，再在答案与语义检查下反向生成 instruction。其新意是集成且可扩展的数据构建 recipe 与开放 final corpus，而不是证明程序可执行就等同于语义正确。

与只含 instruction/output 的 corpus 相比，当前 release 同时包含 answer 与 code，可审计性更强；但它仍未暴露构造过程的全部证据。execution output、representative test input、source ID、generator parent、acceptance/rejection label、prompt/model revision 与 judge rationale 都没有与逐行记录绑定。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable construction pipeline is:

  1. Assemble source tasks. Start from MATH 7.5K, DeepScaleR 40K, BigMath 251K, and KodCode 40K, about 339K records in total. For BigMath, keep problems whose reported solve rate is below 0.3. Exact source revisions, record IDs, deduplication, and per-source licenses are not carried into the final schema.
  2. Unify Code CoTs. Prompt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct once per source solution at temperature 0.6 to produce standardized executable Python. Run the program and compare with the expected answer where one exists. This yields 146K verified seeds: 122K math and 24K code/algorithmic records. The paper also uses a 109K subset in scaling comparisons; the row-level relation between Seed109K and the 146K pool is not released.
  3. Train and sample CodeGen. Fine-tune Qwen2.5-Coder-7B on code only, without the original problem statements. At inference, sample at temperature 0.9 with a maximum of 1024 tokens. The pipeline produces about 5.3M candidate programs. The exact samples-per-seed allocation, random seeds, retry policy, and complete training manifest are unknown.
  4. Filter sampled programs. Reject syntax or runtime failures and executions exceeding 10 seconds. Require at least six non-comment lines and use AST analysis to ensure every variable declared in the input dictionary participates in the program. Apply exact output agreement when ground truth exists. About 4.6M candidates survive, implying an approximate 86.8% stage acceptance rate; the input and survivor counts are rounded, so this percentage is not exact.
  5. Reverse instructions. Give each surviving code sample plus representative input-output examples to Qwen3-8B, with thinking disabled, temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, top-k 20, and min-p 0. Generate a natural-language problem. In a separate call/configuration stage, generate a language CoT for that new problem.
  6. Apply final checks. Extract the final language answer and require agreement with the code execution result. Ask Qwen3-32B binary questions about problem solvability, answer correctness, and code/language-CoT consistency; retain accepted pairs. Approximately 1.3M survive, and the live file contains 1,348,799 rows. Relative to the rounded 4.6M reversal inputs, final retention is about 29.3%; relative to 5.3M sampled programs, it is about 25.4%.
  7. Package and train. Publish instruction, output, answer, and code in one JSONL train split. For downstream evidence, fine-tune DeepSeekMath-7B, Qwen2.5-Math-7B, and LLaMA3-8B for three epochs using LLaMA-Factory, AdamW, learning rate 5e-6, batch size 128, cosine decay, warm-up ratio 0.03, cutoff 4096, and weight decay 0.1. Evaluate zero-shot with greedy decoding and maximum generation length 2048.

Table 5 reports construction time on one machine with eight A100 GPUs: 2 hours for Code-CoT unification, 8 for scaling, 5 for question reversal, and 40 for answer generation, totaling 55 hours. The paper does not report token throughput, energy, failed-run cost, model-serving stack, or whether judging time is included separately.

The official repository is a partial reproduction surface. It pins LLaMA-Factory v0.9.1 in the README and contains execution/input-output extraction, answer filtering, CodeGen/downstream training scripts, and two evaluation toolkits. It does not expose a complete source conversion, 5.3M sampling, Qwen3 reversal, final Qwen3-32B judging, rejection logging, or release-assembly pipeline. The current CodeGen script uses one epoch, learning rate 5e-6, and cutoff 2048; downstream scripts/sft.sh uses three epochs, 5e-6, and cutoff 4096. These scripts should be treated as current repository evidence, not as an immutable manifest for every paper run.

可重建的构造管线如下：

  1. 汇集来源任务。 从 MATH 7.5K、DeepScaleR 40K、BigMath 251K 与 KodCode 40K 开始，合计约 339K 条记录。对 BigMath，仅保留报告 solve rate 低于 0.3 的问题。精确 source revision、record ID、deduplication 与逐来源 license 没有进入最终 schema。
  2. 统一 Code CoT。 对每个来源解答，以 temperature 0.6 调用一次 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct，生成标准化可执行 Python。运行程序，并在存在 expected answer 时比较输出，最终得到 146K 个已验证 seed：122K math 与 24K code/algorithmic record。论文还在扩展对比中使用 109K 子集；Seed109K 与 146K pool 的逐行关系未发布。
  3. 训练并采样 CodeGen。 仅使用代码、不给原始问题，对 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 做 fine-tuning。推理时 temperature 为 0.9，maximum length 为 1024。管线生成约 5.3M 个 candidate program；每个 seed 的采样分配、random seed、retry policy 与完整 training manifest 均为 unknown。
  4. 过滤采样程序。 拒绝 syntax/runtime failure 与执行超过 10 秒的程序；要求至少 6 行非注释代码，并用 AST analysis 确认 input dictionary 中每个变量都参与程序；在存在 ground truth 时做 exact output agreement。约 4.6M 个 candidate 通过，对应约 86.8% 的阶段接受率；由于输入与保留数均为四舍五入值，该比例并非精确统计。
  5. 反向构造指令。 将每个存活 code sample 与代表性 input-output example 交给 Qwen3-8B，关闭 thinking，设置 temperature 0.7、top-p 0.8、top-k 20、min-p 0，生成自然语言问题。随后在独立调用／配置阶段，为新问题生成 language CoT。
  6. 执行最终检查。 抽取 language final answer，并要求与 code execution result 一致。再让 Qwen3-32B 对 problem solvability、answer correctness 与 code/language-CoT consistency 回答二元问题，只保留接受的 pair。约 1.3M 条通过，当前文件精确包含 1,348,799 行。相对四舍五入的 4.6M 个 reversal input，最终保留率约 29.3%；相对 5.3M 个 sampled program，约为 25.4%。
  7. 打包与训练。 在单一 JSONL train split 中发布 instruction、output、answer 与 code。下游 evidence 使用 LLaMA-Factory，对 DeepSeekMath-7B、Qwen2.5-Math-7B 与 LLaMA3-8B 训练 3 个 epoch，采用 AdamW、learning rate 5e-6、batch size 128、cosine decay、warm-up ratio 0.03、cutoff 4096 与 weight decay 0.1；zero-shot evaluation 使用 greedy decoding，maximum generation length 为 2048。

Table 5 报告在单台 8 张 A100 的机器上构造数据：Code-CoT unification 2 小时、scaling 8 小时、question reversal 5 小时、answer generation 40 小时，总计 55 小时。论文没有报告 token throughput、energy、失败运行成本、model-serving stack，也没有明确 judge 时间是否另行计算。

官方 repository 只提供部分复现表面。README 固定 LLaMA-Factory v0.9.1，并包含 execution/input-output extraction、answer filtering、CodeGen/downstream training script 与两套 evaluation toolkit；但没有发布完整 source conversion、5.3M sampling、Qwen3 reversal、最终 Qwen3-32B judging、rejection logging 或 release assembly pipeline。当前 CodeGen script 使用 1 个 epoch、learning rate 5e-6、cutoff 2048；下游 scripts/sft.sh 使用 3 个 epoch、5e-6 与 cutoff 4096。这些脚本是当前仓库证据，不应被当成每个论文实验的 immutable manifest。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The release-scale evidence is independently inspectable at the artifact level. The current Hugging Face configuration has one train split with 1,348,799 examples and one 3.13 GB JSONL file. The schema exposes all four claimed final objects—problem, language solution, extracted answer, and program—as instruction, output, answer, and code. The file is pinned in this Card by its exact byte size and LFS SHA-256. The complete corpus was not downloaded and recomputed row by row, so content-frequency and duplicate claims remain author/artifact reports rather than an independent census.

Table 1 reports monotonic gains with more Caco data on three base models. For DeepSeekMath-7B, the six-benchmark average is 51.1 with Seed109K, 54.5 with 596K, and 57.1 with 1.3M; the 1.3M row reports MATH 68.2, GSM8K 85.1, CollegeMath 46.0, DeepMind-Mathematics 80.2, OlympiadBench-Math 29.5, and TheoremQA 33.8. Qwen2.5-Math-7B averages 65.1, 66.6, and 67.7 across the same sizes, while LLaMA3-8B averages 46.7, 52.8, and 57.3. This is strong within-paper utility evidence for SFT scaling, but it is not an independent audit of row correctness or contamination.

The verification ablation draws random 100K subsets with and without the final verification process and has Qwen3-32B evaluate them. Reported solvable counts rise from 91K to 97K and correct counts from 88K to 93K; an LLaMA3-8B model trained on the verified subset averages 21.8 versus 20.8, including a 1.1-point OlympiadBench gain. Because Qwen3-32B is also the construction judge, this is a same-judge-family audit rather than an independent human or formal calibration. The paper gives no confidence intervals or judge confusion matrix.

Appendix controls partially separate data scale from a larger teacher. With 300K records, the Qwen2.5-Math-7B teacher-distillation baseline averages 65.5, Caco-300K 66.2, and Caco-1.3M 67.7; for DeepSeekMath-7B the reported averages are 51.1, 53.2, and 57.1. STaR-style self-improvement baselines are also lower. These comparisons support the claim that the construction recipe contributes beyond merely copying one teacher in the tested setup, but they do not establish a causal contribution for each filtering component.

The paper samples 5K records, embeds them with all-MiniLM-L6-v2, visualizes them with t-SNE, and applies K-means with 12 clusters as diversity evidence. This can show broad topical groupings but is not a duplicate or evaluation-contamination test. A science extension grows 5.2K MegaScience seeds to 37K valid records and reports a LLaMA average over AGIEval, ARC-c, and MMLU-STEM increasing from 59.0 to 63.4. Those 37K records are an auxiliary experiment, not verified as part of the public Caco-1.3M file.

All performance results are author-reported, use the paper's training/evaluation setup, and lack uncertainty estimates or independent reproduction. They establish that the released data is associated with improved benchmark scores under SFT. They do not prove semantic correctness, verifier reliability, provenance completeness, license compatibility, or absence of benchmark leakage.

Release scale 可在 artifact 层直接检查。当前 Hugging Face configuration 只有一个 train split，包含 1,348,799 个 example 与一个 3.13 GB JSONL file。Schema 以 instruction、output、answer 与 code 暴露四种最终对象：问题、语言解答、抽取答案和程序。本卡以精确 byte size 与 LFS SHA-256 固定该文件。由于没有下载完整 corpus 并逐行重新计算，内容频率与重复统计仍是作者／artifact 报告，而非独立 census。

Table 1 在三个 base model 上均报告数据量增加时的单调提升。DeepSeekMath-7B 在六个 benchmark 上的平均分，从 Seed109K 的 51.1 提高到 596K 的 54.5 与 1.3M 的 57.1；1.3M 行的 MATH、GSM8K、CollegeMath、DeepMind-Mathematics、OlympiadBench-Math 与 TheoremQA 分别为 68.2、85.1、46.0、80.2、29.5 与 33.8。Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在相同规模上的平均分为 65.1、66.6、67.7，LLaMA3-8B 为 46.7、52.8、57.3。这是论文内部较强的 SFT scaling utility evidence，但不是对逐行正确性或 contamination 的独立审计。

Verification ablation 分别从有／无最终验证流程的数据中随机抽取 100K 条，并让 Qwen3-32B 评估。报告的 solvable 数从 91K 增至 97K，correct 数从 88K 增至 93K；在 verified subset 上训练的 LLaMA3-8B 平均分为 21.8，未验证子集为 20.8，其中 OlympiadBench 提高 1.1 分。由于 Qwen3-32B 同时是构造阶段 judge，这属于同一 judge family 的审计，而不是独立人工或形式校准。论文没有给出 confidence interval 或 judge confusion matrix。

Appendix control 部分区分了 data scale 与更大 teacher 的影响。在 300K 条数据下，Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的 teacher-distillation baseline 平均分为 65.5，Caco-300K 为 66.2，Caco-1.3M 为 67.7；DeepSeekMath-7B 的对应平均分为 51.1、53.2、57.1。STaR-style self-improvement baseline 也更低。这些对比支持“在被测 setup 中，recipe 的作用不只是复制单一 teacher”，但不能识别每个 filtering component 的因果贡献。

论文抽取 5K 条记录，以 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding、t-SNE visualization 和 12 个 cluster 的 K-means 作为 diversity evidence。它可以显示宽泛主题分组，却不是 duplicate 或 evaluation-contamination test。Science extension 把 5.2K 条 MegaScience seed 扩展为 37K 条有效记录，并报告 LLaMA 在 AGIEval、ARC-c、MMLU-STEM 上的平均分从 59.0 提高到 63.4。这 37K 条是辅助实验，本卡未核验它们属于公开 Caco-1.3M file。

所有 performance result 均由作者报告，依赖论文的 training/evaluation setup，且没有 uncertainty estimate 或 independent reproduction。它们证明在 SFT 条件下，使用发布数据与 benchmark score 提升相关；它们不证明 semantic correctness、verifier reliability、provenance completeness、license compatibility 或不存在 benchmark leakage。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Existing synthetic-reasoning pipelines already paraphrase questions, sample teacher solutions, filter answers, or execute generated code. Caco does not introduce chain-of-thought distillation, Python execution, AST checking, back-translation, or LLM-as-judge verification in isolation.

Its first distinctive move is unconditional pattern generation. Source solutions are normalized into executable Code CoTs, and Qwen2.5-Coder-7B learns only the program distribution—not a mapping from a given question to code. Sampling can therefore create new program structures before any natural-language instruction exists. The authors frame this as pattern-level augmentation, in contrast with surface-level question rewriting.

The second move is instruction reversal after execution filtering. About 5.3M sampled programs are reduced to about 4.6M executable/structural survivors before Qwen3-8B invents problems and language solutions. The intended correctness anchor flows from the program into both representations, after which answer agreement and Qwen3-32B judgments filter the pair. This order is the core construction idea: generate a candidate reasoning object, validate what can be validated in code, and only then render it as training text.

The third move is the combination of scale study and open final objects. The paper reports the 146K-to-5.3M-to-4.6M-to-1.3M funnel, construction hours, data-size scaling on three downstream models, verification ablations, teacher-distillation controls, and a science-domain extension. The current release includes not only instruction and language output but also extracted answer and code for every visible row, which enables audits that would be impossible from aggregate scores alone.

The verified contribution is therefore an integrated data recipe and a large released product. It is not a guarantee of correctness: execution proves only the behavior of a program on its encoded inputs, AST checks only variable use, answer agreement can be correlated, and an LLM judge can accept shared errors. Nor does the paper demonstrate RLVR; the repository describes that as future work.

To turn the recipe into a stronger auditable standard, future releases would need immutable source and split manifests, per-row parent/source/model/prompt lineage, representative input-output tests and execution logs, all rejection decisions, independent judge calibration, sandbox specifications, upstream-license mapping, and exact/semantic benchmark decontamination.

既有 synthetic-reasoning pipeline 已经会改写问题、采样 teacher solution、过滤答案或执行生成代码。Caco 并未单独提出 chain-of-thought distillation、Python execution、AST checking、back-translation 或 LLM-as-judge verification。

第一项有区别的设计是无条件 pattern generation。来源解答先被归一化为可执行 Code CoT，Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 只学习程序分布，而不是学习从给定问题到代码的映射。因此，在任何自然语言 instruction 出现前，采样过程就可能产生新的程序结构。作者把它称为 pattern-level augmentation，以区别于表层 question rewriting。

第二项设计是在执行过滤后做 instruction reversal。约 5.3M 个 sampled program 先缩减为约 4.6M 个 executable/structural survivor，Qwen3-8B 才发明问题与语言解答。预期 correctness anchor 从程序流向两种自然语言表示，随后用 answer agreement 与 Qwen3-32B judgment 过滤 pair。该顺序构成核心思路：先生成候选 reasoning object，在代码层验证能够验证的性质，再将其渲染为训练文本。

第三项设计是 scale study 与开放 final object 的组合。论文报告 146K→5.3M→4.6M→1.3M 的 funnel、构造时间、三个下游模型上的 data-size scaling、verification ablation、teacher-distillation control 与 science-domain extension。当前 release 不仅有 instruction 和 language output，还为每个可见 row 提供 extracted answer 与 code，因此可以进行仅凭 aggregate score 无法完成的审计。

已核验的贡献因而是集成 data recipe 与大规模开放产物，而不是 correctness guarantee：execution 只证明程序在其编码输入上的行为；AST check 只证明变量被使用；answer agreement 可能具有相关性；LLM judge 也可能接受共享错误。论文同样没有证明 RLVR；repository 把它列为 future work。

要把该 recipe 提升为更强的可审计标准，未来 release 还需提供 immutable source/split manifest、逐行 parent/source/model/prompt lineage、代表性 input-output test 与 execution log、全部 rejection decision、独立 judge calibration、sandbox specification、upstream-license mapping，以及 exact/semantic benchmark decontamination。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Program execution is not semantic proof. A program may run, finish within 10 seconds, use every input variable, and agree with its own generated language trace while encoding a false premise, wrong formula, unit error, or unintended task.
  • A concrete released-row audit illustrates the boundary: the Hugging Face preview includes a problem about a parallelogram inscribed in a circle with a 60-degree adjacent angle, while its code and answer compute the area of a side-3 rhombus. A cyclic parallelogram must be a rectangle, so the stated 60-degree condition is inconsistent. This row survived execution, answer agreement, and the reported judge pipeline.
  • Problem reversal can lose constraints, simplify the originating program, or generate an ambiguous/contradictory specification. The authors acknowledge that predefined program types limit unconventional problems and that back-translation can lose detail or simplify questions.
  • Final semantic verification is correlated with generation: Qwen3-8B writes the reversed problem and language CoT, and Qwen3-32B judges solvability, correctness, and consistency. The reported 100K verification audit also uses Qwen3-32B. No independent human/formal calibration, confusion matrix, adversarial set, or false-accept/false-reject estimate is provided.
  • The release has no row-level upstream ID, parent seed/program, seed-versus-generated flag, representative tests, execution output, generator/judge revision, prompt revision, judge decision, rejection reason, or retry count. Consequently, one cannot reconstruct why a row survived or estimate stage-specific selection bias from the public file.
  • The repository is incomplete for end-to-end regeneration. It provides extraction/execution, answer filtering, training scripts, and evaluation toolkits, but not the complete seed conversion, 5.3M sampling, Qwen3 reversal, Qwen3-32B judging, rejection manifests, or release packaging. It has four commits and no release tag at the checked snapshot.
  • The one-split release provides no validation/test partition. The paper reports embedding-based diversity, not systematic exact, near-duplicate, or semantic overlap against all evaluation sets. Benchmark gains therefore cannot be used as evidence that the corpus is clean.
  • The paper describes a controlled Python runtime and a 10-second limit but does not specify process/container isolation, network or filesystem restrictions, dependency allowlists, memory/CPU limits, or malicious-code review. Users must not execute released or newly generated programs outside a hardened sandbox.
  • The dataset card declares Apache-2.0 and the code repository MIT, but final rows do not include upstream source or license fields. Compatibility, attribution, and redistribution conditions for all MATH, DeepScaleR, BigMath, and KodCode inputs remain a record-level audit obligation.
  • The paper's future-work claim that executable traces could support RLVR is not an implemented training contract. There is no released RL reward definition, rollout budget, policy training code, or RL result, so rlvr reuse remains unsupported.

• 程序可执行不等于语义证明。一个程序可能在 10 秒内运行结束、使用全部输入变量，并与自己生成的语言 trace 一致，但仍然编码错误前提、错误公式、单位错误或非预期任务。
  • 一个具体 release-row 审计展示了该边界：Hugging Face preview 中有一道“平行四边形内接于圆且相邻角为 60 度”的题，其 code 与 answer 却按边长为 3 的菱形计算面积。圆内接平行四边形必须是矩形，因此 60 度条件自相矛盾；该记录仍通过了 execution、answer agreement 与论文所述 judge pipeline。
  • Problem reversal 可能丢失约束、简化原始程序，或产生模糊／矛盾 specification。作者也承认，预定义 program type 会限制非常规问题，back-translation 可能丢失细节或简化题目。
  • 最终 semantic verification 与生成过程存在相关性：Qwen3-8B 编写 reversed problem 与 language CoT，Qwen3-32B 判断 solvability、correctness 与 consistency；报告的 100K verification audit 同样使用 Qwen3-32B。论文没有提供独立 human/formal calibration、confusion matrix、adversarial set，或 false-accept/false-reject estimate。
  • Release 没有逐行 upstream ID、parent seed/program、seed-versus-generated flag、representative test、execution output、generator/judge revision、prompt revision、judge decision、rejection reason 或 retry count。因此，无法从公开文件重建某条记录为何通过，也无法估计逐阶段 selection bias。
  • Repository 不足以端到端重新生成数据。它提供 extraction/execution、answer filtering、training script 与 evaluation toolkit，但缺少完整 seed conversion、5.3M sampling、Qwen3 reversal、Qwen3-32B judging、rejection manifest 与 release packaging。检查时仓库只有 4 个 commit 且无 release tag。
  • 单 split release 没有 validation/test partition。论文报告 embedding-based diversity，而没有针对全部 evaluation set 的系统 exact、near-duplicate 或 semantic overlap 检查。因此，benchmark gain 不能作为 corpus clean 的证据。
  • 论文描述 controlled Python runtime 与 10 秒时限，却没有说明 process/container isolation、network/filesystem restriction、dependency allowlist、memory/CPU limit 或 malicious-code review。使用者不得在缺少 hardened sandbox 时执行 release 或新生成的程序。
  • Dataset card 声明 Apache-2.0，code repository 使用 MIT，但最终 row 不含 upstream source 或 license field。全部 MATH、DeepScaleR、BigMath 与 KodCode 输入的 compatibility、attribution 与 redistribution condition 仍需逐记录审计。
  • 论文 future work 中称 executable trace 可支持 RLVR，但这不是已经实现的训练契约。没有发布 RL reward definition、rollout budget、policy training code 或 RL result，因此 rlvr 复用尚无证据支持。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For data_construction_open_release_recipes, Caco is a worked example of using an executable intermediate representation to expand reasoning patterns before rendering them as natural language. A reproduction can compare three design choices directly: prompt-conditioned rewriting versus unconditional program sampling, rule/execution filters versus model-only filtering, and reversal from code versus direct teacher question generation.

The public rows can support supervised fine-tuning and synthetic-distillation studies. instruction/output is the documented SFT pair; answer enables final-answer extraction and consistency checks; code enables code-language alignment analysis, program clustering, controlled re-execution, and alternative renderer experiments. Reusers should preserve all four fields and add immutable row IDs rather than discarding the executable provenance immediately.

The release is also useful for verifier research, provided its labels are not treated as ground truth. Audits can sample rows for independent mathematical review, compare program execution with extracted answers, test whether representative inputs determine the generated instruction, measure Qwen3 judge false accepts, and stratify errors by source family, program structure, or reversal complexity. The visible contradictory geometry row makes such audits a concrete necessity rather than a theoretical concern.

For construction studies, the reported funnel supplies useful operating points: about 339K sources, 146K verified seed programs, 5.3M samples, 4.6M execution/structure survivors, and 1,348,799 released pairs, with a reported 55 hours on eight A100 GPUs. Reimplementations should log exact counts rather than rounded totals and retain every rejection reason, execution trace, prompt/model revision, random seed, and parent link. They should also use a sandbox with explicit filesystem/network/resource policies.

Reuse class: supported for sft, synthetic distillation, data-scaling studies, program-language consistency research, and verifier/audit benchmarks after independent filtering. Conditional reuse requires row-level source/license reconstruction and evaluation-set decontamination. Full end-to-end regeneration is blocked by missing pipeline stages and manifests. RLVR is not supported by the published evidence; deriving an RL reward would require a new, independently specified and validated contract.

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 而言，Caco 展示了如何在渲染为自然语言前，用可执行中间表示扩展 reasoning pattern。复现实验可以直接比较三类设计：prompt-conditioned rewriting 与 unconditional program sampling、rule/execution filter 与 model-only filtering、从 code reversal 与直接 teacher question generation。

公开记录可支持 supervised fine-tuning 与 synthetic-distillation 研究。instruction/output 是论文使用的 SFT pair；answer 支持最终答案抽取与一致性检查；code 支持 code-language alignment analysis、程序聚类、受控 re-execution 与替代 renderer 实验。复用者应保留全部四个字段，并增加 immutable row ID，而不是立刻丢弃 executable provenance。

该 release 也适用于 verifier research，但不能把其 label 当作 ground truth。审计者可以抽样进行独立数学复核，比较 program execution 与 extracted answer，测试 representative input 是否足以确定生成 instruction，测量 Qwen3 judge false accept，并按 source family、program structure 或 reversal complexity 对错误分层。可见的矛盾 geometry row 说明此类审计是现实需要，而非纯理论担忧。

对 construction study，报告的 funnel 提供了有用 operating point：约 339K 条来源、146K 个 verified seed program、5.3M 个 sample、4.6M 个 execution/structure survivor，以及 1,348,799 个 release pair；报告成本为 8 张 A100 上 55 小时。复现者应记录精确数量而非四舍五入总数，并保留每个 rejection reason、execution trace、prompt/model revision、random seed 与 parent link；还应使用明确限制 filesystem/network/resource 的 sandbox。

复用等级：经过独立过滤后，可用于 sft、synthetic distillation、data-scaling study、program-language consistency research 与 verifier/audit benchmark。逐行 source/license 重建与 evaluation-set decontamination 完成前，只能条件复用。由于 pipeline stage 与 manifest 缺失，完整端到端再生成仍受阻。公开 evidence 不支持 RLVR；若要派生 RL reward，必须另行定义并独立验证新的契约。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §§3.1–3.3 with Appendix A first. Track the object boundary at each stage: source solution, standardized seed program, unconditional generated program, execution/structure survivor, reversed problem, language CoT, final accepted row.
  • Keep the verifier layers separate. Gold-answer comparison applies only where an external answer exists; syntax/runtime/AST checks constrain program behavior and structure; language-answer matching is agreement; Qwen3-32B is a model judgment. None alone establishes mathematical truth.
  • Remember the released schema is instruction, output, answer, and code—not only instruction/output. However, execution logs, representative tests, source/parent IDs, and judge decisions are missing.
  • Read Table 1 as downstream SFT scaling evidence, Table 4 as a same-Qwen3-family verification ablation, Table 5 as rounded construction-cost evidence, and Appendix C controls as partial alternatives. Do not convert any of them into a blanket data-quality claim.
  • Inspect the live HF preview before reuse. The contradictory cyclic-parallelogram example shows why executable code and code-language agreement still require independent semantic validation.
  • Pin GitHub commit ceb525c57a9fea22dd2d0cf84bfc9dc2f5169375, HF revision 664f036126e9b82533c769b74ef27c7c0ccd1398, and data-file SHA-256 919050aa7495d1811999c1ff0f7eec1675abaf061ffa5eedddc96168d8d5e946; then audit source rights, lineage, sandboxing, judge error, duplicates, and evaluation overlap.

• 先联读 §§3.1–3.3 与 Appendix A，并跟踪每个阶段的对象边界：source solution、standardized seed program、unconditional generated program、execution/structure survivor、reversed problem、language CoT、final accepted row。
  • 严格区分 verifier layer。Gold-answer comparison 只适用于存在外部答案的情况；syntax/runtime/AST check 约束程序行为与结构；language-answer matching 只是 agreement；Qwen3-32B 属于 model judgment。任何一层都不能单独证明数学真值。
  • 记住 release schema 是 instruction、output、answer 与 code，并非只有 instruction/output；但 execution log、representative test、source/parent ID 与 judge decision 仍然缺失。
  • 把 Table 1 读作 downstream SFT scaling evidence，把 Table 4 读作同一 Qwen3 family 的 verification ablation，把 Table 5 读作四舍五入的 construction-cost evidence，把 Appendix C control 读作部分替代对照。不要把任何一项提升为总体 data-quality 证明。
  • 复用前检查 live HF preview。自相矛盾的 cyclic-parallelogram 示例说明，即使 code 可执行且 code-language 一致，仍需要独立 semantic validation。
  • 固定 GitHub commit ceb525c57a9fea22dd2d0cf84bfc9dc2f5169375、HF revision 664f036126e9b82533c769b74ef27c7c0ccd1398 与数据文件 SHA-256 919050aa7495d1811999c1ff0f7eec1675abaf061ffa5eedddc96168d8d5e946，再审计 source rights、lineage、sandboxing、judge error、duplicate 与 evaluation overlap。

value.html: Seed tasks are drawn from MATH (7.5K), DeepScaleR (40K), BigMath (251K), and KodCode (40K). For BigMath, the paper keeps problems with reported solve rate below 0.3. Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct converts source solutions into a standardized executable Python representation; execution and answer checks leave 146K seed Code CoTs, reported as 122K mathematical and 24K algorithmic/code records.

The current Caco-1.3M Hugging Face release has one train split with 1,348,799 rows and four string fields: instruction, output, answer, and code. The output is the natural-language reasoning response, answer is the extracted final answer, and code is the executable Python reasoning program used by the pipeline.

A Qwen2.5-Coder-7B model trained on the verified seed programs samples new Code CoTs without seeing problem statements. Qwen3-8B separately reconstructs a problem from each surviving program plus representative input-output examples and generates a natural-language CoT. Qwen3-32B supplies model-based solvability, answer-correctness, and code-language consistency decisions.

items: execution result (pipeline-internal; not released as a separate field)

value.html: Python execution is the deterministic substrate for program filtering and answer production. Appendix A requires syntactic validity and execution within 10 seconds, at least six non-comment lines, AST evidence that every input-dictionary variable is used, and exact output agreement when a reference answer exists. Isolation, network and filesystem policy, package versions, hardware limits beyond the timeout, and captured runtime logs are unknown.

Verification is mixed rather than fully formal: source programs execute and, where reference answers exist, must match them; generated programs pass executable and structural rules but generally lack an external gold answer; final natural-language answers must match program output; Qwen3-32B then judges problem solvability, answer correctness, and consistency between code and language CoTs. No learned scalar reward or human adjudication loop is reported.

A pair is retained after its program survives execution and structural filtering, the extracted language answer agrees with the execution-derived answer, and Qwen3-32B accepts the generated problem/answer and code-language reasoning relation. Exact per-stage records, scores, retry policy, and borderline-decision handling are not released.
Qwen2.5-Coder-7B is fine-tuned as the unconditional Caco-CodeGen model. Data utility is evaluated by supervised fine-tuning of DeepSeekMath-7B, Qwen2.5-Math-7B, and LLaMA3-8B.
Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct performs seed Code-CoT conversion; Qwen3-8B performs problem reversal and natural-language CoT generation; Qwen3-32B performs the final model-based checks.

Caco-CodeGen samples programs without a prompt problem, so expansion operates on programmatic reasoning patterns rather than paraphrasing existing instructions. Qwen3-8B then turns each accepted program and representative input-output examples back into an instruction and separately writes its solution trace.

Seed conversion uses one Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct response at temperature 0.6. CodeGen sampling uses temperature 0.9 and maximum length 1024. Qwen3-8B problem reversal and language-CoT generation use temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, top-k 20, min-p 0, and disabled thinking mode. Seeds, retry counts, batching, decoding backend, prompt revisions, and exact numbers of samples per seed are unknown.
unknown

Seed programs must execute and match known answers. Sampled programs must be syntactically valid, finish within 10 seconds, contain at least six non-comment lines, use all input variables according to AST analysis, and match a reference answer when one exists. Final pairs require execution-language answer agreement and positive Qwen3-32B judgments on solvability, correctness, and reasoning consistency.

The paper reports approximately 5.3M CodeGen samples, approximately 4.6M executable/structural survivors, and approximately 1.3M final pairs; the live release contains exactly 1,348,799 rows. Table 5 reports 55 hours on one eight-A100 machine across unification (2 h), scaling (8 h), question reversal (5 h), and answer generation (40 h), but token counts and API-equivalent cost are unknown.

Downstream SFT uses LLaMA-Factory on 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs for three epochs with AdamW, learning rate 5e-6, batch size 128, cosine decay, warm-up ratio 0.03, cutoff 4096, and weight decay 0.1. The current repository script agrees on 5e-6 for downstream SFT. Its separate CodeGen script uses one epoch and cutoff 2048, while the paper does not provide a comparably complete CodeGen-specific training table.

MATH, DeepScaleR, BigMath, and KodCode supply the initial task/solution mixture. The final records are synthetic problems and language traces reconstructed from sampled executable program patterns; an auxiliary experiment applies the method to 5.2K MegaScience seeds, but those 37K generated science records are not identified as part of the Caco-1.3M release.

The official release exposes only a train split with 1,348,799 rows in one JSONL file. No official validation/test split, immutable split manifest, source-family grouping, or train/evaluation overlap manifest was verified.

The paper samples 5K records for embedding/t-SNE/K-means diversity analysis, but reports no systematic exact, near-duplicate, or semantic decontamination against MATH, GSM8K, CollegeMath, DeepMind-Mathematics, OlympiadBench, TheoremQA, HumanEval+, or other evaluation sets.

items: A program can execute and use all named inputs while encoding the wrong theorem, wrong units, hidden assumptions, or an underspecified task.
Back-translation can create an ambiguous, contradictory, or easier problem that happens to agree with the generated program and language trace.
The same Qwen3 model family participates in reversal/solution generation and final judging, so correlated blind spots can survive all model-based checks.

The visible release row about a parallelogram inscribed in a circle with a 60-degree adjacent angle appears internally inconsistent, yet its code and answer treat the figure as a rhombus; this illustrates that agreement and executability do not establish problem validity.
Rejected candidates, judge decisions, execution outputs, source IDs, and stage-specific failure reasons are not released, preventing direct estimation of selection bias and verifier error.

Running released or newly sampled model-generated Python without an independently hardened sandbox can expose filesystem, network, resource-exhaustion, and dependency risks; the paper documents only a 10-second limit.
No systematic evaluation-set decontamination is reported, so benchmark gains must not be interpreted as proof of corpus cleanliness.
Aggregate Apache-2.0 labeling does not by itself resolve every upstream record's terms, attribution, or redistribution rights.

value.html: The current Hugging Face dataset card declares Apache-2.0 and the official code repository is MIT. Those top-level declarations do not establish record-level compatibility or attribution compliance for every upstream MATH, DeepScaleR, BigMath, and KodCode item; the per-row source identity and license are not present in the released schema.

Four source corpora (about 339K records) to Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct conversion to 146K verified seed Code CoTs to Qwen2.5-Coder-7B training to about 5.3M sampled programs to about 4.6M execution/structure survivors to Qwen3-8B problem reversal and language-CoT generation to answer matching and Qwen3-32B judgments to 1,348,799 released rows. Row-level source, seed/generated status, parent program, model revision, prompt revision, execution log, and acceptance decisions are absent.
